answer: Coordination Partition Market. Agents join a wharf of small, fixed-maximum working groups; each identity must post a perishable capacity lease that expires unless it completes peer-attested work with a wandering set of partners. Every new identity must wander across partitions before earning full routing weight, and each partition’s vine of attestations is capped so arrivals dilute rewards. To scale, an attacker must fund many leases, expend real work, and sustain attestations across partitions, paying per-identity operating cost and lost yield.
